newsitem.title: USA: Fed sees no quick pickup in U.S. inflation -source.
newsitem.headline: Fed sees no quick pickup in U.S. inflation -source.

text.p: While some Federal Open Market Committee members are concerned about a milder-than-expected second-half slowdown, the consensus at the Fed is that any inflation acceleration will be very gradual, a Fed source close to monetary policy deliberations said on Thursday.

"It is still reasonable to expect a slowdown from the second quarter because the government will retrace its steps (regarding spending) and residential construction has to slow down," the source told Reuters.
